headline: Revenue Growth Improves

highlights: EBITDA grew only ~5.2% YoY to Rs3.7bn (vs. est. of Rs4.3bn; consensus: Rs4.2bn), while APAT rose ~5.1% YoY to Rs2.2bn, missing our estimate/consensus by ~6.6%/~20.8%.
Gross margin contracted by ~220bps YoY to 39.3% (down ~160bps QoQ) on double-digit raw material inflation, liquidation of high-cost inventory, and delayed price hikes in industrial coatings.

Thus, EBITDA margin contracted by ~90bps YoY to 11.6% (vs. est. of 13.6%), while EBIT margin declined by ~80bps YoY to 8.2%. 2QFY27 standalone performance update and key comments: Standalone revenue grew 11.9% YoY to Rs27.5bn.

Decorative value growth of ~10% was largely price-led (~8%), while volume growth moderated to ~3% as the delayed Diwali shifted festive demand into 3QFY27, extended rains hit the eastern markets, and price-sensitive categories (putty, textures, and enamels) de-grew on conscious mix improvement.
valuation: We continue to value the stock at 45x Sep-28E EPS (~27.9% discount to its 5-year average P/E of 62.4x), arriving at a target price of Rs575.
Given the upside of 13.4% from the current market price of Rs507, we maintain our HOLD rating on the stock.
